The dataset consists of collected raw data for composition of different slags and ashes. The dataset contains two different sheets with the first displaying composition as found in the sources and the second displaying the composition with slight editing incl. harmonization of unit of measurement (to wt%) and transformation of compounds into elements. V2: addition of intro and overview page and second data sheet (harmonized dataset) V3: minor corrections in the dataset
